name: reconciliation-pack
title: Supplier reconciliation review pack
for_each: select r.id,s.name from runs r join batches b on b.id=r.statement_id join suppliers s on s.id=b.supplier_id

sections.title: Source totals
sections.sql: select kind,as_of,currency,lines,total_cents,declared_cents from v_batches where id in (select statement_id from runs where id=$1 union all select ledger_id from runs where id=$1)

sections.title: Line reconciliation
sections.sql: select reference,outcome,statement_cents,ledger_cents,detail from findings where run_id=$1 order by reference

sections.title: Evidence and explanations
sections.sql: select f.reference,x.actor,x.note,x.evidence from resolutions x join findings f on f.id=x.finding_id where f.run_id=$1

sections.title: Follow-ups
sections.sql: select actor,note,due_date from notes where supplier_id=$1 order by due_date
